 Summary
 Greenwood equalises for Fenerbahce against Liverpool in Champions League after Nyoni had put Reds in front
 Barcola and Ngumoha start but no recognised striker in Liverpool XI - full team news 
 Bellingham scores for Real Madrid against AEK Athens with lovely flick
 Man City travel to Leipzig and Arsenal face Slavia Prague at 20:00 GMT

 Get involved Live Reporting
 Sam Drury
 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 18:30 GMT 18:30 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Every time Szoboszlai plays in midfield we look more vulnerable. Not sure what he offers to the team other than the occasional spectacular goal.
 Keith 
 81 177 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Well, he's at right-back tonight, Captcb7. Playing two position at once might be tricky.
 74 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:29 GMT 18:29 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Liverpool need to consider Gomez at left-back again. Defence needs to be solidified.
 Captcb7 
 195 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 41 mins 41 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce win a corner as they continue to make life difficult for Liverpool.
 They've really come to life since falling behind and haven't stopped since equalising.
 50 149 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 39 mins 39 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Trey Nyoni has been excellent for Liverpool but he's caught in possession on the edge of his own box here and Fenerbahce work the ball to Mason Greenwood.
 The striker works half a yard but drags the left-footed shot wide.
 152 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Barcola's unlucky' published at 18:26 GMT 18:26 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Good movement from Bradley Barcola getting across the defender. He's a little bit unlucky.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 228 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:25 GMT 18:25 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Love Munoz in the team. So direct and always wants to beat his man. May not have the tricks of Rio but he has dynamite in his boots.
 David 
 495 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 37 mins 37 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce deal with a couple of corners before another ball is dinked in and Bradley Barcola gets his head to it.
 It sneaks just wide but Ederson was a little worried for a moment.
 149 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 36 mins 36 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Liverpool do manage to get the ball down and string a few passes together before finding Victor Munoz on the right.
 He races past his man yet again before a second defender comes across to concede the corner.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 203 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 This ground is buzzing published at 18:22 GMT 18:22 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 This ground has burst into life after that Fenerbahce equaliser. Liverpool have been really good but this will be a solid test now because the Turkish side have grown in confidence after the leveller.
 Great half of football so far.
 127 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:22 GMT 18:22 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Since Fenerbahce scored there has been a real increase in their tempo. They have been really impressive.
 64 166 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce get another free-kick, 20 yards inside the Liverpool half, and whip it into the box.
 The away side clear eventually but it wasn't entirely panic free.
 38 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - AEK Athens 1-1 Real Madrid published at 18:22 GMT 18:22 GMT 
 Jude Bellingham (32 mins) 
 Just moments after having a goal disallowed for offside, Jude Bellingham levels for Real Madrid and it's a stunner.
 The England midfielder guides Marc Cucurella's fizzing delivery into the goal with a sensational flick like it's the easiest thing in the world.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 222 134 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Always a concern Liverpool will concede out of nothing' published at 18:20 GMT 18:20 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 Liverpool have dominated the game but Fenerbahce's chances - and now their equaliser - show that there is still always a concern with Andoni Iraola's side that they will concede a goal, even out of nothing. 
 They are so open, and keep getting caught on the counter-attack.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 121 172 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 31 mins 31 mins 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce are buoyed by that goal and come forward again with Romelu Lukaku.
 He gets into a good position inside the area but opts to cross rather than shoot and Liverpool escape.
 The visitors need to regain their composure and try to quieten the crowd once more.
 121 66 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:18 GMT 18:18 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Tsimakas is a lazy liability and I don't know how he gets a game for Liverpool.
 Danny 
 528 210 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Jacquet turns his back' published at 18:18 GMT 18:18 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 I think the goalkeeper will not be too happy with his wall. Alisson is livid. Jeremy Jacquet turns his back. You have to stand up and take it.
 Not good defending.
 260 157 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fenerbahce 1-1 Liverpool published at 29 mins 29 mins 
 Mason Greenwood 
 Now Fenerbahce are level!
 Dominik Szoboszlai gives away a free-kick 25 yards out, Mason Greenwood takes it and the ball takes a big deflection off Jeremy Jacquet to beat Alisson.
 Not dissimilar to the one at the other end, probably a bigger deflection but the result is the same - we're all square.
 Image source, Reuters 
 568 1733 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Fenerbahce fans are furious published at 18:16 GMT 18:16 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 0-1 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 The Fenerbahce fans are furious. They feel like they should have had a penalty just seconds before that goal and now Dirk Kuyt is getting booked. This game is fizzing into life.
 219 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 27 mins 27 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-1 Liverpool 
 Almost an immediate response from Fenerbahce!
 They race forward down the left, a low ball is put in and Irfan Can Kahveci smashes it against the bar!
 There might have been an offside in there but it was tight.
